title: A Clock for the Atlas
author: Freya Dunmore
blurb: Ada Sandoval, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
